title: Map labelling #7
topic: wildlife park · botanical garden · holiday village · sports centre
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the penguin pool. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the butterfly house. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the café. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The picnic area is directly behind the penguin pool, at the back of the site.
Guide: The gift shop is right next to the picnic area, on its left side.
Guide: The reptile house is directly behind the butterfly house, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the visitor centre is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the cactus house. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the sculpture lawn is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The herb garden is directly behind the sculpture lawn, at the back of the site.
Guide: The play area is directly behind the cactus house, at the back of the site.
Guide: The souvenir stall is directly behind the visitor centre, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the bike hire. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the campfire circle is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the shop. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The restaurant is directly behind the campfire circle, at the back of the site.
Guide: The games room is directly behind the shop, at the back of the site.
Guide: The nature trail office is right next to the games room, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the climbing wall is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the swimming pool is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the creche is the first building on your left.
Guide: The physio room is directly behind the climbing wall, at the back of the site.
Guide: The weights room is directly behind the creche, at the back of the site.
Guide: The changing rooms is right next to the physio room, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
